# Templates

A marketplace of around a dozen starter apps. Each card is a real
one-shot **create + deploy** — pick a template and Cantila provisions the
project, wires its platform services, and deploys the app.

## Using a template

From the Console, browse the gallery at [`/templates`](/templates) and
click a card to create and deploy in one shot. The new project ships with
its [platform services](/docs/auto-wired) auto-wired — `DATABASE_URL` and
storage resolve before the first build.

## From the CLI

```bash
# List available templates
cantila templates

# Create + deploy from a template
cantila templates use <template-id>
```

## What you get

Each template create produces a normal Cantila project:

- A dedicated managed [Postgres database](/docs/databases) wired as `DATABASE_URL`.
- S3-compatible object storage.
- A scoped `CANTILA_API_KEY`.
- A running deploy you can immediately open.

From there it behaves like any other project — deploy updates, attach a
[custom domain](/docs/domains), and let the [agents](/docs/agents) keep it
healthy.

<Note>
  Templates are live. Each one is a working create + deploy, not a
  placeholder.
</Note>
